headline: Honda recalls over 800,000 vehicles in the US over Takata airbag defect
summary: Honda is recalling 810,592 Acura and Honda vehicles in the United States due to safety risks of Takata airbag inflators rupturing, according to NHTSA filings.
why: Mass automobile recalls trigger warranty repair expenses and regulatory scrutiny for major Japanese vehicle manufacturers operating in North America.

impacts.name: Honda Motor
impacts.why: The recall of over 810,000 units in the US adds warranty and dealer repair costs.
